'''Ezogelin soup''' or '''Ezo gelin soup''' ({{langx|tr|Ezogelin çorbası}}, "the soup of Ezo the bride") is a common [[soup]] in [[Turkish cuisine]]. The main ingredients are [[bulgur]] and [[lentil|red lentils]]. The origin of the soup is attributed to Ezo the bride from [[Gaziantep]].<ref>[http://foodblogandthedog.wordpress.com/2011/05/11/ezogelin-turkish-red-lentil-soup-with-mint-and-sumac/ Origin of Ezogelin soup, and vegan, gluten-free version of the recipe.]</ref> 

Common ingredients include [[red lentil]]s, [[rice]], [[bulgur]], [[olive oil]], [[onion]], [[garlic]], [[tomato]], [[tomato paste]], [[paprika]], [[Aleppo pepper]], dried [[Mentha|mint]], [[black pepper]], and [[Edible salt|salt]]; it is usually served with [[lemon]] wedges.<ref>{{Cite web |last=HasanzadeNemati |first=Shadi |date=2024-10-02 |title=Ezogelin Soup (Turkish Red Lentil Soup with Bulgur) |url=https://www.unicornsinthekitchen.com/ezogelin-soup/ |access-date=2025-09-18 |website=Unicorns in the Kitchen |language=en-US}}</ref>
